items.label: On the ballot
items.text: Running for the full four-year term on Nov. 3, 2026: Mission Local (Oct. 8, 2026) says the District 2 incumbent "won handily in June" and is "on track to win the next four-year term"; after the June 2 special election he said he hoped to "earn four more years this November." Search summaries: the sf.gov candidate report says four people qualified for District 2; GrowSF and Blue Voter Guide list Sherrill, Nicholas Berg, Guy McCoy and Monthanus Ratanapakdee. (sources: Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/10/sf-meet-the-candidates-congress-supervisor-school-board/ [fetched page, secondary]; Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/06/sf-district-2-supervisor-november-sherrill-brooke/ [fetched page, secondary]; San Francisco Department of Elections https://www.sf.gov/reports--candidates-nov-3-2026-general-election [search summary, primary]; GrowSF https://growsf.org/voter-guide/san-francisco-voter-guide-november-2026-election/contests/district-2-supervisor/ [search summary, secondary]; Blue Voter Guide https://bluevoterguide.org/district/CA/San_Francisco_Board_of_Supervisors_District_2/54158/638 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Incumbent
items.text: Yes. Mission Local: "Mayor London Breed appointed Sherrill in December 2024 after Stefani vacated the seat to become one of San Francisco’s state assembly members." He won the June 2, 2026 special election, which "would only guarantee him the remainder of Catherine Stefani’s term, which ends in January 2027." CivLab lists him as D2 Supervisor from 2024-12-18 with type "elected" (CivLab's label differs from the appointment). (sources: Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/06/sf-stephen-sherrill-lori-brooke-district-2-special-election/ [fetched page, secondary]; CivLab (Michael Adams), SF Gov Graph data https://graph.civlab.org/sf [fetched page, secondary])
